acme_admin: Hey @support — our daily usage CSV for 2026-01-12 is missing a chunk of rows between ~11:30–12:15 UTC. The invoice shows token usage for that window but the export is blank. Can you look?

jane_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the org id and a tiny snippet of the CSV (headers + 1–2 rows) where the gap appears? Also did you use the API export or the Console 'Download CSV' button?

acme_admin: Org: org_0xACME. We used the Console export (CSV). Attaching the cut-down snippet below — you can see rows jump from 11:28 to 12:16: 

"timestamp,route,model,tokens_in,tokens_out,region"
"2026-01-12T11:27:10Z,/v1/chat-req,gpt-open-8k,120,300,us-west-2"
"2026-01-12T12:16:02Z,/v1/chat-req,gpt-open-8k,90,210,us-west-2"

acme_admin: We also compared the Dashboard time-series and it shows steady traffic through that period (no drop). Invoice picked up ~1.2M tokens for the day which matches dashboard, not the CSV export.

jane_support: Thanks. Two quick checks while we triage: 1) can you confirm timezone setting used when downloading (UTC vs local)? 2) If you pull the raw usage export API (GET /v1/usage/export?org=org_0xACME&start=2026-01-12T00:00Z&end=2026-01-13T00:00Z) do you see the same gap?

acme_admin: Timezone = UTC. Raw API call gave the same CSV. I can share the full file privately if that helps.

sara_data: Looping in data infra. I can see a pattern: ingestion backfill for shard-2026-01-12 failed for the hourly-aggregation job between 11:00–12:30 UTC. That would cause the export to miss aggregated rows while the invoice (which uses eventual metering) and real-time dashboard (streamed metrics) still show usage.

sara_data: To validate, run this internal query against billing_events (we run this internally):

"-- find missing hourly aggregates for org on date
SELECT hour_bucket, count(*) as events
FROM raw_token_events
WHERE org_id = 'org_0xACME' AND event_ts BETWEEN '2026-01-12T11:00:00Z' AND '2026-01-12T12:30:00Z'
GROUP BY hour_bucket
ORDER BY hour_bucket;"

sara_data: I also checked the aggregation logs — job id agg-20260112-3 exited with nonzero due to a transient S3 ListObjects error while reading shard prefix s3://redwood-usage/shard-3/2026-01-12/. The raw events exist; we just didn't finish the hourly reduce. We should backfill that hour.

mike_billing: Thanks for the diagnosis. For the customer-facing fix we should: 1) run the backfill, 2) regenerate export, 3) apply a provisional credit for the delta until export and invoice reconcile. Can you estimate the missing tokens so I can pre-authorize the credit?

sara_data: Based on raw events for that window I see ~1,234,560 tokens (inbound+outbound) that didn't make it into the CSV. Quick calc from sample rows: 

"SELECT SUM(tokens_in+tokens_out) FROM raw_token_events WHERE org_id='org_0xACME' AND event_ts BETWEEN '2026-01-12T11:30:00Z' AND '2026-01-12T12:15:00Z';"

sara_data: Result: 1234560. I'll attach a small checksum (md5) of the raw blob we used to compute that.

jane_support: mike_billing — can we provisionally credit 1.24M tokens (rounded) while we backfill? If yes, I can reply to the customer with next steps and ETA.

mike_billing: Yep approve provisional credit of 1.24M tokens. We'll show a credit line on the account and mark the invoice as 'under review'. Finance will reconcile after the backfill completes.

tom_sre: Scheduling backfill now. Command I'm running (internal tool):

"usage-backfill --org org_0xACME --start 2026-01-12T11:00:00Z --end 2026-01-12T12:30:00Z --shard 3 --priority high"

ingest-bot: Backfill job queued: id=fb-20260112-9, queued_by=tom_sre, eta=~45m

sara_data: I'll monitor the reduce and re-run aggregation verification. After backfill we should re-export CSV and compare a checksum diff against the previously downloaded file. Steps I'll take: 1) run backfill, 2) run aggregate_verify.py --org org_0xACME --range 2026-01-12T11:00Z/2026-01-12T12:30Z, 3) produce CSV and diff, 4) hand to billing for reconciliation.

jane_support: I'll reply to the customer now with expected timeline (~1hr) and that we've provisionally applied a credit of 1.24M tokens.

acme_admin: Thanks. Can you confirm when backfill completes and share updated CSV? We need to attach to our internal audit.

ingest-bot: Backfill job started: id=fb-20260112-9, started_at=2026-01-12T15:20:00Z

sara_data: Backfill complete, job id=fb-20260112-9. Verification result: aggregate_verify -> OK. Generated new CSV: s3://redwood-exports/org_0xACME/2026-01-12-verified.csv (md5: 9b1f5e2...)

mike_billing: Confirming provisional credit applied earlier will be reconciled. Final invoice adjustment queued; finance will update within 3 business days.

jane_support: Closing loop with customer now. Any follow-ups, file a ticket for automation to detect failed hourly-aggregates and auto-queue backfill (SRE/tracking: #ENGINFRA-849).

acme_admin: Excellent, appreciate the quick turn. :tada:

jane_support: Glad we got it. Closing thread.
